messages:
jen: seeing a spike of 5xx on embed-service (eu-west1) — ~6% errors and p95 latency up. Canary image v2026.03.19-rc4 flaked. Proposing emergency pin to `embed:v2026.03.19-hotfix1` and a controlled traffic shift (20%) in the 01:00-01:15 UTC change window. Need fast-track signoff from ops + eng.

matt: +1 to pin if no schema/migration. rollback plan?

jen: no DB schema changes. rollback = traffic revert + set image back to `v2026.03.18`. KV cache warm strategy: drain prefixes, then stop prefixing.
Rollback criteria: sustained error rate >2% for 2 min OR p95 > 400ms.

ops_oncall: oncall here — I'll monitor. paste the exact deploy command and smoke checks. I'll keep pager open.

jen: deploy command: `kubectl set image deploy/embed embed=ghcr.io/redwood/embed:v2026.03.19-hotfix1 -n prod-eu`
Smoke checks: `curl -sS https://eu1-api.redwood.ai/embed/health` expect `OK`; run one sample embed and ensure cosine diff < 0.5 vs baseline. Watch logs for `embed-worker` OOMs.

deploy-bot: :information_source: deploy request received from jen — pipeline #8452 queued. CI status: unit ✅, integration ✅. Required approvals: 2 (eng + ops). Current approvals: 0.

sara: ops approval here, LGTM. :+1:

matt: eng approval from me. hold for deploy-bot to start.

deploy-bot: pipeline #8452 started — initiating canary at 5% traffic. Monitoring window 5m.

jen: kicking canary now.

deploy-bot: canary completed: error rate 0.6% (was 6%), p95 210ms. No OOMs observed. Shifting to 20% as planned.

ops_oncall: watching dashboards — logs/ traces look normal for the moment. I'll trigger pager if errors creep.

jen: QA sanity checks done: sample embed matches baseline; similarity delta within threshold. Proceeding to hold 5m then full shift.

sara: approved for full shift from ops side.

matt: agreed. If anything regresses, abort and revert to `v2026.03.18`. Rollback assigned to ops_oncall.

ops_oncall: acknowledged — rollback playbook ready.

jen: adding release note: "embed: emergency bump to v2026.03.19-hotfix1 to address eu-west1 503s; image pinned; canary validated; rollback criteria defined."

deploy-bot: pipeline #8452 finished SUCCESS — deploy annotated in release notes. :tada:

jen: thanks everyone. leaving a follow-up ticket to run a cache-warm job and post-mortem for root cause.
